title: Exploring Temporal Context-Aware Physical Grounding in Latent World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.28483v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning latent dynamics is fundamental to building action-conditioned world models for planning. Among existing families, Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) offer a natural framework by modeling transitions directly in latent space rather than at the pixel level. However, two issues remain in JEPA-based world models: (i) physical grounding lacks explicit aggregation of temporal context and (ii) action planning always overly relies on generic sampling distributions. To this end, we propose $\mathcal{G}$-JEPA, which incorporates temporal context into physical grounding for latent world models and couples the learned models with prior-guided action planning. Specifically, during learning, we incorporate a shared causal temporal module that aggregates temporal context within observation and prediction sequences under physical state supervision, grounding both in task-relevant physical states. translated_title: 探索潜空间世界模型中时间上下文感知的物理接地
translated_abstract: 学习潜空间动力学是构建用于规划的动作条件世界模型的基础。在现有的模型家族中，联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）通过直接在潜空间而非像素级别对状态转移进行建模，提供了一个自然的框架。然而，基于JEPA的世界模型仍存在两个问题：（i）物理接地缺乏对时间上下文的显式聚合；（ii）动作规划总是过度依赖通用的采样分布。为此，我们提出了G-JEPA，它将时间上下文融入潜空间世界模型的物理接地中，并将学习到的模型与先验引导的动作规划相结合。具体而言，在学习阶段，我们引入了一个共享的因果时序模块，在物理状态监督下聚合观测序列和预测序列中的时间上下文，使两者都能接地于与任务相关的物理状态。在规划阶段，我们进一步引入……
tldr: 提出G-JEPA，通过共享因果时序模块在物理状态监督下将时间上下文融入潜空间世界模型的物理接地，并结合先验引导的动作规划，解决了现有JEPA世界模型缺乏时间上下文聚合和过度依赖通用采样分布的两大问题。
